def check_subsequences(s, t):
    # Create a list to track if each character in s is used in a valid subsequence
    used = [False] * len(s)
    
    # Index to track position in t
    t_index = 0
    
    # Iterate over each character in s
    for i in range(len(s)):
        # If the current character matches the current character in t
        if s[i] == t[t_index]:
            # Mark this character as used
            used[i] = True
            # Move to the next character in t
            t_index += 1
            # If we have matched the entire t, break early
            if t_index == len(t):
                break
    
    # Check if all characters in s were used in at least one valid subsequence
    if all(used):
        return "Yes"
    else:
        return "No"
